We write to travelers

Travel Notice for Companion Animal Guests

Please check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk early so we can help you and your pet move through booking, wait areas, and pickup with less stress. Keep your carrier labeled, follow staff directions, and let us know right away if your travel plans change.

If you are traveling with a reptile, <<FACT F060>> Bring the required health papers with you, and keep them ready for review at the desk. <<FACT F084>> Our team will look over the details and guide you through the next steps with care.

Aurelia Skyways expects prompt, respectful communication from travelers, and we will give the same in return. If you need help at any point, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
